correctness.rationale: Let nonnegative F3 Plücker coordinates mean 0 or 1 after projective normalization, n≥2. Each rank-two 4-index Plücker relation lifted to ordinary integers is between −1 and 2, so divisibility by 3 implies it vanishes over Z. This gives a real totally nonnegative rank-two plane and cyclic-block positroid. Four parallel classes would give a forbidden 1−1+1=1 relation; hence c∈{2,3}. Conversely any cyclic rank-two positroid with 2 or 3 blocks has explicit F3 column directions (1,0),(1,1),(0,1) with all nonzero ordered minors 1 (signed cyclic reindexing handles wrap); supports are unique. McNeill toric⇔regular and rank-two regular⇔c≤3 then give bijection. For nonloop size m, cyclic c-block partitions are indexed by choices of c circular gap cuts, giving binom(n,m)binom(m,c) and variety dimension m+c−4. Summation proves T_n(z)=binom(n,2)(1+z)^{n−2}+binom(n,3) z²(1+z)^{n−3}. Independently enumerated all normalized F3 RREF planes for n=2..6 and matched dimension histograms. The unrefined count was already published and is explicitly not claimed new.
